title: Naturality of the composite global tensor-Hom adjunction
statement: Let C be a braided closed monoidal category, B a category, and c:B→C left adjoint to s:C→B. For an arrow c(Q)⊗E→K, define tr using the composite c followed by tensor-left-E adjunction and the braiding; define ev by the counit with the inverse braiding. The transpose is natural in Q and K and contravariantly natural in E. Evaluation is natural in both E and K: for f:E′→E and k:K→K′, pulling ev(E′,K′) through the induced global Hom morphism gives ev(E,K) after whiskering f and postcomposing k. These are the precise typed source, target, parameter and ev_naturality equations of the Lean module.

source.place: Stacks Tags 08J9 and 0A90: adjunction, evaluation and tensor naturality; the categorical formal calculation is written out in Lean.

proof.text: Expand the composite adjunction Hom equivalence. Adjunction naturality in the source and target proves parameter and target naturality. Curry naturality and braiding naturality prove coefficient naturality.

The transpose of evaluation is the identity by the counit identity. The transpose is injective since it is an adjunction bijection after an invertible braiding. Transpose both sides of evaluation naturality, apply the three preceding identities, and cancel the bijection.

theorem ev_naturality {E E' K K' : C} (f : E' ⟶ E) (k : K ⟶ K') :
    (c.map (s.map ((MonoidalClosed.pre f).app K) ≫
      s.map ((ihom E').map k)) ▷ E') ≫ ev a E' K' =
    (c.obj (s.obj ((ihom E).obj K)) ◁ f) ≫ ev a E K ≫ k
